description: Live broker truth for read-only portfolio and execution analytics, with historical Console coverage kept honest.

novel_features.description: Show each order with the executions and partial fills it spawned.

novel_features.description: Compute current P&L, concentration, turnover, and win/loss summaries from live rows.

novel_features.description: Report which broker and deferred Console capabilities are safe to use.
